name: otel-as-code
description: otel-as-code: vendor-neutral OpenTelemetry for your repo, generated by your coding agent and checked by CI.

plugins.name: otel-as-code
plugins.description: See what your services are doing in production. Adds OpenTelemetry tracing, metrics and logs to your code, shows them on a free local dashboard, and generates monitoring setup for Grafana, Datadog, New Relic or Dash0.
